name: Smart Image Optimizer AI Lite
author: inlinestudio

sections.description:
Smart Image Optimizer AI Lite scans your WordPress Media Library for missing ALT text
and uses Google Gemini AI to create short, SEO-optimized descriptions automatically.

Improve your website’s accessibility, SEO, and image metadata quality — easily and securely.
All AI calls use your own Google API key, with no data stored externally.

Upgrade to Pro for unlimited image scans, bulk AI generation, daily automation, and reports.
👉 Upgrade here

Features

  • 🧠 Generate ALT text using Google Gemini AI
  • 📸 Scan your media library in one click
  • 💾 Instantly save ALT text to WordPress metadata
  • 🌐 100% GDPR-compliant (your API key, your data)
  • ⚡ Lightweight and fast

Pro version includes:
– 🤖 Unlimited scans (no daily limits)
– ⚡ Bulk AI generation
– 📅 Daily auto-scan for new uploads
– 📊 ALT report + CSV export
– 🔁 OpenAI & custom endpoint support

✨ Upgrade to Pro →

External services

This plugin connects to the Google Gemini AI API provided by Google.

It uses this external service to automatically generate descriptive ALT text for images in the WordPress Media Library.

When generating ALT text, the plugin sends:
– The image file URL (a public or authenticated link from your Media Library)
– The Gemini API key you provide (from your own Google AI Studio account)

No personal user data, login details, or analytics are transmitted.
The API key is stored locally in your WordPress database under the sioai_gemini_key option and is never shared externally.

The Google Gemini service is provided by Google LLC:
– Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Users can revoke their Gemini API key at any time directly in their Google account settings.

Upgrade

Upgrade to Pro for unlimited AI scans, automation, and SEO tools:
👉 https://inline-studio.co.il/smart-image-optimizer-ai
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/smart-image-optimizer-ai-lite/
  2. Activate it via “Plugins” in WordPress
  3. Go to Media → Smart Image Optimizer AI
  4. Get your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio
  5. Paste your key and click Save Settings
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for the Gemini API?

No. Google provides free monthly usage for the Gemini API.

Where do I get my Gemini API key?

Go to Google AI Studio, click “Create API Key,” and copy it.

Is this GDPR-compliant?

Yes. The plugin uses your API key directly; no external storage or tracking is used.
